title: Security Patrol Log Entry - 21:20 Pass (EV003)
prompt:
1) Function: Capture a forensic-quality close-up photograph of a handwritten security patrol log entry showing a documented “21:20” pass.
2) Scene / Composition: A single open patrol logbook lies flat on a plain, unbranded gray desk surface, with only the relevant log page visible and centered. The log entry line containing “21:20” is the visual focus and occupies about 25% of the frame height, with surrounding lines faintly visible for context. Include a small, plain, unmarked metric scale card (black ticks on white, no logos) placed parallel to the bottom edge of the page, positioned near the lower margin without covering any writing. Use raking light from camera-left to emphasize pen impressions and paper texture while keeping all text readable. No hands, no pens, no additional objects.
3) Angle & Distance: Angle 85° from horizontal (near top-down), subject distance 0.42 m.
4) Optics & Technique: 50 mm lens, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5000K; focus on the “21:20” line with deep DOF to keep the full entry sharp; minimal distortion, no artistic effects.
5) Mandatory elements: The patrol log entry must clearly show the time “21:20” and the word “Pass” on the same line; no other required labels, timestamps, camera IDs, or case identifiers.
6) Negatives: Must not include faces, people, fingerprints as intentional focal content, official badges/crests, real company names, real addresses, phone numbers, QR codes, barcodes, logos/brands, credit cards/IDs, license plates, or any printed case/evidence identifiers; must not show the evidenceId or “EV003” written inside the image; no excessive shadows obscuring text; no blur, glare hotspots, or moiré.
7) Acceptance checklist:
- Single color photograph, forensic-quality clarity.
- Close-up of an open patrol logbook page on a plain gray surface.
- The “21:20” and “Pass” text are clearly legible on the same entry line.
- Raking light from the left reveals paper/indentation without obscuring writing.
- One unmarked metric scale card is present and not covering any text.
- No logos, real names, faces, IDs, barcodes/QRs, or case/evidence identifiers appear.
- Near top-down view with minimal perspective distortion and sharp focus across the entry.
